solutions.title: Sort descending
solutions.strategy: Sort the array and index the kth value from the end.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Java's in-place primitive sort uses stack space, while Python's list sort may allocate temporary merge buffers.

solutions.title: Min-heap size k
solutions.strategy: Maintain a min-heap containing the k largest values seen so far.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value may trigger one heap operation bounded by heap size k.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The heap stores at most k values.

solutions.title: Quickselect
solutions.strategy: Partition around pivots until the target sorted index is placed.

timeComplexity.explanation: Balanced partitions inspect linear total work on average, but unlucky pivots can repeatedly shrink by one.
